test_title: SSC MTS Previous Year Paper (Held on: 12 July 2022 Shift 3)
subject: general
question: Six friends A, B, C, D, E and F are sitting around a circular table facing the centre (not necessarily in the same order). A sits third to the left of D. D sits to the immediate right of B. B sits second to the left of E. C sits second to the right of F. Who sits second to the right of A?
solution:
Given: Six friends A, B, C, D, E and F 

1) A sits third to the left of D. 

2) D sits to the immediate right of B. 

3) B sits second to the left of E. 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/131b22c5a0281d35d91d2711da9d87df4bade884ac7eaaf2927d14d18949c861.png] 

4) C sits second to the right of F. 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/0fef248217eb72105521bef5ab1ff20ab38a9623818c640180d0140e1090889a.png] 

So, B sits second to the right of A.

Hence, the correct answer is **"B"**.
